tellings.difference: Dates the visit to 2022 and adds the sulfur smell, which the corpus holds as a separate story (host-smelled-sulfur-at-skinwalker-ranch-2022).

as_told.title: Host's tri-field meter dies and he smells sulfur

tellings.quote: Like a tri-field meter went off because of high gamma radiation.
tellings.difference: Attributes the meter going off to high gamma radiation, rather than draining.
tellings.link_reason: Host's own Skinwalker Ranch visit where a tri-field meter went off, matching the drained trifield meter story.

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a famous paranormal hotspot in Utah's Uintah Basin, Jesse Michels says a trifield meter, a handheld device that measures electromagnetic fields and radiation, went off just before his group left: it had a full battery, was flashing, and then was dead. Michels tells it himself as something he saw, on several occasions. In one telling he dates the visit to 2022 and also mentions smelling sulfur, and in another he says the meter went off because of high gamma radiation, rather than describing it draining.
